native.provenance: Version-matched cached runtime; selected patches do not modify native code

verification: Exercise the compiled binary in a separate session using synthetic files and an explicitly authorized per-launch approval overlay

maintenance.main: Upstream mirror only; no fork customizations
maintenance.contributions: Independent topic branches and upstream PRs; never base an independent feature on the aggregate build
maintenance.integration: Create a fresh candidate from the pinned upstream commit, cherry-pick selected commits in patches order, then add this manifest; never develop features directly in the candidate
maintenance.publication: After verification, publish a fresh fork/build-* branch and immutable fork-* build tag; never force-update a published build tag
maintenance.distribution: Install versioned artifacts and point the separate omp-fork launcher at the selected verified build; retain prior builds for rollback
maintenance.acceptedUpstream: Omit a patch from the next candidate only once its behavior is included in the pinned upstream baseline; reconcile squash or rewritten merges explicitly
maintenance.rejectedUpstream: Retain desired rejected changes as fork-only patches without coupling unrelated PRs
maintenance.updates: Rebuild through this queue; do not use the official updater to replace a fork artifact
maintenance.policy: Building or selecting a fork artifact does not itself change approval configuration
